name: eidas-signature-check
title: eIDAS Signature Validator: Check Signed PDFs & XML (QES, EU)
description: Is this signed document genuine? Validates PDF signatures, XAdES/XML signatures and EU Official Journal seals against the official EU trusted lists: intact, signer, qualified (QES) or not, changed after signing. ALLOW / REVIEW / BLOCK for contracts, invoices and AI agents.
